drop: Drop an EML, EMLX or MSG file here to extract its attachments
privacy: Your email and attachments stay in this browser. No uploads or remote content.
invalid: Choose a readable EML, EMLX or MSG email file.
unsupported: This saved item or one of its attachment types cannot be extracted. Export a complete email with embedded files and try again.
protected: Encrypted or protected emails cannot be opened. Export a readable copy from your mail app and try again.
incomplete: This email is incomplete or an attachment could not be read. Export a complete copy with all embedded attachments and try again.
resource: The browser could not allocate enough resources. Close other tabs or try another device.
engineUnavailable: The email reader could not start. Reload the page or try a current browser.
noAttachmentsDescription: This email does not contain any attachment files that can be downloaded.
zipFailed: The ZIP could not be created. Try fewer attachments or download files individually.
inlineNotice: Inline resources are marked and start unselected. Select them to include them in a ZIP.
namesNotice: Download names are adjusted when needed to avoid unsafe names or duplicates. Original names remain visible.
nestedNotice: Attached Outlook messages are saved as standalone MSG files.
fidelity: Extract embedded files from saved EML, EMLX and MSG emails. Download attachments individually or create a ZIP containing the files you select. Empty attachments remain empty files.
limitations: Only embedded attachment contents are available. Incomplete, encrypted and externally linked attachments cannot be extracted. No attachment is previewed or executed, and no remote content is fetched.
verificationNotice: Sender identity, digital signatures and delivery have not been verified.
